# opencode-zen-proxy — for AI agents

A local gateway exposing OpenCode Zen free-tier LLMs as OpenAI/Anthropic APIs.

- Base URL: http://localhost:6446/v1 (LAN: http://<host>:6446/v1)
- No API key required by default
- Endpoints: POST /v1/chat/completions (OpenAI, stream supported),
  POST /v1/messages (Anthropic), GET /v1/models (working free models only),
  GET /health
- Streaming includes reasoning (reasoning_content), tool_calls, content
- Working free models (2026-10-07): big-pickle, exo-free, fledge-alpha-free,
  ling-3.1-flash-free, longcat-2.5-preview-free, mimo-v2.6-flash-free,
  muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free, muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free,
  nemotron-3-ultra-free, nemotron-3.5-lightning-free, space-bunny-free
- Setup: `python setup.py` (starts opencode serve :4096 + proxy :6446)
- Requires the `opencode` CLI installed for the recommended routing path
- Educational use only; not affiliated with OpenCode
